summary: Fresh build. Ran full backend pytest suite (30 tests, all passing) covering auth, sub-admin CRUD, member creation, revocation cascade, items CRUD & isolation, transactions (stock_in/out/move/adjust), dashboard, low-stock, and main-admin cross-team edits. Ran mobile-viewport Playwright UI tests covering login, home top bar, summary card & dot switch, bottom nav title changes, sub-admin creation with '10d left' badge, limited-sub access-bar text ('Your access ends in 10 days.'), add item -> item details (SKU/₹cost/stock summary), stock_out from item -> transaction details (before/after 50->45), transactions filter, tx-add adjust picker (search + items), locations add/list, team rename reflected on home top bar, subscription tile visible for limited sub, and revoked sub login shows toast 'Your access has been revoked. Contact your admin.' and stays on /login.

issues: Uses native window.confirm() for delete confirmation — inconsistent with the rest of the app (which uses shadcn dialogs/toasts) and looks out of place on mobile. Recommend replacing with an AlertDialog for consistent UX.
React warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the shadcn Dialog for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional) Replace window.confirm on locations delete with a shadcn AlertDialog for consistent UX.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to Sub Admin / Member add dialogs to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py check_access: when a member's owner has non-limited access_type but is is_active=false, current logic correctly raises 403. However access_info() computes 'days_left' rounding via (secs+86399)//86400 which gives ceil-days; consider clamping to <= days requested to avoid showing e.g. '11d left' immediately after creation (in practice it returns 10, so fine).
inventory_routes._apply_transaction: no MongoDB transaction / lock — concurrent stock updates could race. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

team_routes.update_sub_admin: when body only contains shop_name, no user 'update' object is built and only teams is updated — behaviour is correct but returns {'ok': True} even if sub_id was invalid but shop_name provided (teams.update_one silently does nothing). Consider checking matched_count for teams too.
team_routes.update_member: returns 200 with 'ok:True' when body has no updatable fields (update is empty). Should probably return 400 or short-circuit; not a functional bug.
auth_routes._set_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview; login also returns tokens in body enabling Bearer usage — good.
server.py seed_main_admin only updates password when it doesn't match — good idempotent seed; email is lowercased on store. Login is case-insensitive — verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and mobile UI flows pass. If retesting, run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 -v (module-scoped fixtures depend on serial execution; do NOT parallelise). Use viewport 390x844 for frontend. Detail/form pages (item details, transaction details, item form, sub admins) don't render BottomNav — navigate via URL or back arrow instead of nav-* testids.
